defect.summary: The Mac agent opened its local Commander server once at module scope with no retry and the MCP SDK's default 60 s request timeout.
defect.observedFailures: Three exits with code 1 recorded in the agent log as 'McpError: MCP error -32001: Request timed out' with data.timeout 60000; each dropped the channel connection and any in-flight request.
defect.secondFailureMode: A stdio child that died after startup left the agent running against an unreachable server. Every later job failed and launchd had no crash to restart, so the connector degraded silently.
defect.notTheCause: The LaunchAgent already sets KeepAlive and ThrottleInterval 30, so crashes were restarted; an earlier reading of this session that claimed KeepAlive was absent was wrong and is corrected here.

fix.retryingConnect: capped exponential backoff to 60 s, explicit 120 s connect timeout
fix.reconnectOnDeath: Client.onclose clears the cached client so the next job reconnects on demand
fix.singleFlight: concurrent jobs share one connection attempt and never spawn competing servers against the same state directory
fix.diagnostics: unhandledRejection and uncaughtException handlers installed ahead of all startup work; log then exit(1) so launchd restarts a clean process
fix.unchanged: journal execution ownership, recovery semantics, catalog, transport code, runtime

regressionTest.method: spawns the real agent binary against a local server that exits non-zero on its first two starts
regressionTest.patched: retries with increasing backoff, proceeds past connect, passes in about 5 s
regressionTest.previousBuild: hangs in connect and never retries; fails at the 100 s test timeout

liveVerification.deployed: channel worker and Netlify front door report connector 0.4.5; Mac agent repinned to release 95bc32666630ad17
liveVerification.killTest: SIGKILL of the live Commander stdio child (pid 76291) while the agent ran
liveVerification.result: agent survived with launchd runs still 1, meaning it was never restarted; the next job over the deployed ChatGPT OAuth/MCP path spawned a new server (pid 77011) and completed, returning 36 tools, a ping on 1.6.0-rc.5 and a pipe worker with its output
